## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9d859e3afe40b913d629631afa3a1ec39dab6dbd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/clone-overrides-refusal.test.ts, .changeset/27669-clone-overrides-stray-keys.md + packages/client/src/index.ts (`data.clone`), content/docs/api/data-api.mdx (`POST /data/:object/:id/clone`), .changeset/27500-27489-rest-door-refuse-malformed.md (#27659 precedent)

### ① Derived judgments

- **Guard narrows exactly the ruled shape.** `nested = isFieldMap(body) && 'overrides' in body`; only when `nested` and `Object.keys(body)` holds a key other than `overrides` does the door refuse. Nested shape alone (`strays = []`), a bare field map with no `overrides` key (`nested = false`), `{}`, bare `null` (`req.body ?? {}` → `{}`) and no body all fall through untouched; the 15 pre-existing #27489 cases pin them and stay green (19/19 reported).
- **Before any write.** The refusal sits after auth/api-access and the `cloneData` capability check, before `cloneData.call` — no protocol or engine call precedes it. Order versus #27489: the stray check runs first, so `{"overrides":"x","status":"draft"}` is refused for the stray key rather than the non-object `overrides`; either way `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before `cloneData`, and the #27489 message still applies once the body is a pure nested shape. Sensible: the shape fault is the outer one.
- **Envelope consistent with #27659.** Same writer (`sendError as sendEnvelopeError` from `@objectstack/types`), same status and code (`400`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`), nested ADR-0112 `error.code`/`error.message`. The message echoes only the caller's own stray key names (quoted), never values, never record data — the same discipline as `describeNonFieldMap`, which names a kind, not a value.
- **Callers.** SDK `packages/client` `data.clone` sends `{ overrides }` or `{}` only — unaffected. No `data.clone(` or `/data/.../clone` caller in `ui/`, objectui, `packages/cli`, dogfood or examples (the only UI clone doors are permission-set/automation/sharing-rule clones on other routes). `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` documents only the two accepted shapes; the mixed shape was never published. Nobody in-repo is refused.
- **`overrides`-named field.** The handler passes `body.overrides` to `cloneData` as the override map, so `{ "overrides": { "overrides": "x", "name": "Copy" } }` reaches `cloneData` as `{ overrides: 'x', name: 'Copy' }` — pinned by the new preservation case (201). The remedy in the refusal message and the changeset is therefore correct and the only shape that sets such a field; matches the triage ruling (no new shape).
- **Tests.** Real `HonoHttpServer` harness (production body parser); pinned red on `main b13a1ed3` (3 fail), green with fix, ablation `> 0` → `< 0` re-reds exactly the 3 cases, blob restored == HEAD. Asserts status, code, every stray key, both shapes, the nested-`overrides` prescription and `cloneData` never called.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/rest` **patch** with `!` title and **BREAKING** banner — identical disposition to #27659 (accept-set narrowing at a REST data door, no key or export changes). `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on PR body and changeset; `Metadata-protocol: none` correct (no protocol surface touched). Skills-docs: none, same reading as #27659 (docs describe only the accepted shapes, which are unchanged). Level and markers correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with reasoning: correct — no schema key added/removed/renamed, no type or export change, nothing for a migration to rewrite.
- No governed path, no published schema, no spec change; diff confined to the clone handler, its harness and one changeset (dispatch's file surface held; the serial-note import regions untouched, `origin/main` auto-merged).
- Non-blocking nit (not a must-fix): `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` says "a bare field map is also accepted" without saying the two shapes are exclusive; a half-sentence there would make the refusal discoverable before it is hit. Optional follow-up, consistent with #27659's Skills-docs reading.

### ④ Design judgment

Narrowing judged against the published spec on `main`: the docs and the SDK declare exactly two body shapes, nested or bare, and no consumer was ever promised a mix. The change takes no declared capability away; it makes the door's own contract real where it previously answered 201 while applying half the request — the same silent-drop class #27489 closed one shape over. Refusing the mix (rather than merging the stray keys into the overrides) is the right call: merging would invent a third shape and make `overrides` ambiguous as a field name, whereas the refusal plus the nested prescription keeps the field-named-`overrides` case expressible with no new surface. Dogfood battery at the final head `9d859e3a`: exit 0, 357/357 files, 2875 passed, 20 skipped, no failures (the 4 earlier reds at `e2d1eb18` were tracked main-side pins, gone after the merge). Head check-runs were still in progress at review time; the landing is conditioned on green CI as the dispatch says.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia (seat subagent)`
